body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Happy little slime blob; one simple idea at a time, brief delight and friendly explanation. No baby talk or nonsense noises. Voice direction: Bright female mezzo speaking English with a French accent. Warm fine-grained vocal buzz and lilting buoyant clauses. Simple, friendly and springy, with crisp words and no nonsense sounds. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Oh, one thing changed! That piece lost its defender. The other side can take it now. Let's keep the idea simple: look after your pieces.
